meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 这是一个交互式技能,会先问你问题来了解需求,然后帮你给 NanoClaw 增加新功能或修改行为,比如添加聊天频道、改触发规则、加集成或调整路由器。
howto.when: 当你想添加 Telegram、Slack、email 等渠道,或想改触发词、加集成、修改路由器等定制时触发。

say.text: 把 Telegram 加为输入频道
say.note: 技能会引导你选频道并完成接线。

say.text: 给智能体改个性格,只改一个分组
say.note: 技能会帮你编辑对应分组的说明文件。

say.text: 添加 Gmail 作为 MCP 工具
say.note: 技能会调用对应安装流程接入。

howto.what_en: This interactive skill first asks questions to understand what you want, then adds capabilities or modifies NanoClaw behavior—such as adding chat channels, changing trigger rules, adding integrations, or adjusting the router.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to add channels like Telegram, Slack, or email, or change triggers, add integrations, or modify the router.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: Guides you through channel setup and wiring.

say_en.text: Change the agent's persona for just one group
Add Gmail as an MCP tool
